_readme: Curated street knowledge that Bay County's public layers do NOT cover, plus a
record of labels read by eye off the builder's published site plans.
build_features.py derives most streets geometrically from county road
centerlines, address points and parcel site addresses; this file only fills
gaps and records what still needs confirming.
* Transcribe exactly what is printed. Never normalise, abbreviate or invent.
* Never infer a full name from a clipped label - put it in `unverified`.
* A name only goes under a phase if it was read inside that phase's boundary.
`unverified` holds labels that were partially legible. They are printed in the
map's 'needs confirmation' block and never drawn on the map as fact.

two_number_series.warning: Minto lot numbers and county house numbers are different series. Never quote a lot number to a buyer as an address.
two_number_series.minto_lot_numbers: Phase-prefixed from Phase 4 onward (4xxx ... 10xxx); phases 1-3 use one unprefixed run of 1-381. A plan-and-plat convention only. Useful for identifying a phase, useless for searching a listing.
two_number_series.county_house_numbers: The searchable street address. Derived from county parcel site addresses (DSITEADDR) and published per street per phase in streets_by_phase.md.
two_number_series.worked_example: Minto lot 8042 sits in Phase 8, but every Escape Avenue address is 9xxx - the county range is 9201-9499 in Phase 7 and 9502-9667 in Phase 8. Searching '8042 Escape Ave' finds nothing.

_note: The full list of streets running through more than one recorded phase is
generated into streets_by_phase.md from county data. This section holds only
the extra detail read off Minto's site plans that county data cannot supply.

address_boundary_on_the_ground.rule: On Escape Avenue, 9499 and below is Phase 7; 9502 and above is Phase 8.
address_boundary_on_the_ground.source: Bay County TEST_Parcels/MapServer/1 DSITEADDR, 209 parcels, assigned by point-in-recorded-plat
address_boundary_on_the_ground.verified_independently: Derived twice, in two sessions, from the county parcel layer. Both runs returned Phase 7 9201-9499 (129 parcels) and Phase 8 9502-9667 (80 parcels). Note there are no county ADDRESS POINTS on Escape Ave - the parcel layer is the only source.

UNVERIFIED: These are Minto LOT numbers, not house numbers. Never quote them as an address.
Lot-by-lot side assignments have not been cross-checked against county parcel geometry.
Phase 8 north loop street name. All 80 Phase 8 parcels return 'ESCAPE AVE', which supports the loop staying Escape Avenue, but does not prove the cul-de-sac is not separately signed.
Three parcels share house number 9551 (all Phase 8) - probably a multi-parcel or common-area record. Do not use 9551 as an on-camera example.
